fields: h, intro, cols [requirement, how, regulation A, regulation B], rows [[t, how, clausesA, clausesB]] (clauses split on "," and ";", a "(g)" after "11.10(d)" reads 11.10(g)), fold (phones only), fold_noun.
best_for: ClauseCrosswalk sets a table of requirements against two regulations' clauses as an editorial crosswalk: the requirements large down the middle, each regulation a spine at the outer edge with its name set big and vertical and its clauses as chips, and a wire from every requirement to every clause it cites.
